description: A classic three-circle Hidden Mickey is drawn into a hand-painted cloud mural in the loading-area queue. It sits in the upper right of the mural and is easy to miss because it reads as just another cloud.

whereToLook.scene: Large hand-drawn mural of backyard coaster plans
whereToLook.exactSpot: Upper right section of the painted clouds near the loading area

bestTip: Most visible when the line slows and you can scan the mural
funFacts: The cloud's position is a subtle nod to the former Earful Tower, the park's iconic water tower that once stood in this area.
